C29.decision: No aircraft spawn: removed stand footprint
C29.basis: 2015 permanent gate-removal chart notice archived by NTSB; 2025 aerial shows service space and no stand/jetway. Passenger map still lists C29.
C29.confidence: Evidence supports omission; reopening after aerial capture not independently confirmed.

E6.decision: No aircraft spawn: former stand within E5/E7 apron
E6.basis: 2025 aerial and mapped aircraft lead-ins show no independent E6 stand between E5 and E7. Historical removal report is supporting evidence only. Passenger map still lists E6.
E6.confidence: Conservative scenery interpretation; no current airport-issued stand-allocation drawing obtained.
